title: Claude just turned that lead generation service into one sentence
description:
Businesses pay lead gen agencies thousands of dollars a month for lead lists that half bounce. Claude just turned that entire service into one sentence.

The connector is called Vibe Prospecting, an official Claude connector built by Explorium. You type something like find me 50 UK SaaS founders using n8n, and Claude returns a structured list with verified emails, phone numbers and company data. Behind it sit more than 50 B2B data sources covering over 150 million companies and 800 million professionals, plus the signals agencies charge extra for: hiring trends, funding events, and the exact tools each company runs.

Every list saves to a hub where you export, enrich and filter, no separate CRM needed. Setup takes a minute: Claude Settings, Connectors, search Vibe Prospecting, Connect. Will it close deals for you? No. It hands you the list your agency used to bill you for. Selling is still your job.

Comment LEAD and I'll send you the link.

#ai #claude #leadgeneration #b2b #sales #aitools #startup #entrepreneur #artificialintelligence #ainews
